title: Strong orthogonally equivariant Stiefel deformation of all rank-three weighted pseudocircle arrangements, including the finite-support direct limit
difficulty_reason: H3: the old2061 fixed-chirotope realization contraction applies within one combinatorial type and does not construct a global deformation across changing cell structures and vanishing weights. The author supplies the additional nonroutine mechanism: piecewise-geodesic straightening on spherical cells, projective pseudoline coarsening with orientation-cover lifting and continuity through zero-weight classes, preservation of single-crossing arrangements in the special three-element case including horizon/axis/origin limits, and nested permutation recursion with distance-to-domain stopping times and stability of future basis choices. That recursion must remain continuous even where all unused weights vanish although the stopping times themselves need not be continuous there. A separately compatible finite-prefix construction yields the finite-support direct-limit deformation for n=infinity, before the standard polar-normalization closing step. These authored global compatibility and degeneration arguments carry the H3 burden; the old fixed-realization core, individual support claims, finite/infinite cases and classifying-bundle consequences are not counted again.

editorial_notes: One exact Theorem2.7.2 global H3 unit for all n>=3 finite and n=infinity as author-defined finite-support direct-limit union. The two quotient outcomes and classifying Corollary2.7.3 remain related applications, not extra IDs.

Preserve rank3, all spanning weighted pseudocircle arrangements, positive nonzero weights plus the distinguished trivial zero pseudosphere, and the weighted Frechet metric for finite n. Do not restrict the global source to unit weights or one fixed chirotope.

For n=infinity, preserve trailing-zero identification and the direct-limit topology of finite-support arrangements/frames. The author explicitly warns that the infinite sup-metric topology is different; do not substitute arbitrary infinitely supported sequences or sup-norm convergence.

Preserve strong O3-equivariance for the right action/precomposition, fixing the target Parseval Stiefel frames throughout. Quotients are O3 for ordinary Grassmannian and SO3 for the oriented Grassmannian.

The full global proof supplies X_I/Y_I/Z_I, piecewise-geodesic f_I, projective pseudoline h_I and orientation-lift continuity, finite recursive g_I with stopping times and basis stability, the separate consistent finite-prefix infinite construction and polar normalization. Do not replace them with a chosen-basis construction valid only on a proper open subset.

Distance-to-domain stopping times s_Ij are continuous on U_I only. Retain the author separate proof of global deformation continuity when all unused weights vanish; do not silently strengthen the stopping-time statement itself.

Existing2061 and the full original canonical-coordinate, equivariant Kneser and conformal interpolation arguments are reused inputs. We do not independently recertify them or count the weighted/unoriented fixed-realization variants again.
Retain all inline author TikZ/xy diagrams and original formula/notation conventions literally. No assistant proof completion, coordinate repair or added assumptions.
Universal/classifying statements are retained with the original paracompact-base category and local-triviality construction. Do not generalize the bundle classification to arbitrary base spaces.

The MacPhersonian conjecture is explicitly left open in the introduction; Question3.1.6 asks simultaneous pre/postcomposition equivariance, beyond the one-sided action used here. Preserve them as uncounted open context, not conclusions. No higher-rank extension claimed.
The complete work was published once through old2061 association. This reference entry adds no second original source/PDF copy or new compile.

core_obligations: Rank3 only; exact n in{3,4,...} or n=infinity defined by finite support and direct-limit topology.
Global source includes weighted pseudocircle arrangements across all combinatorial types and vanishing weights; target is the Parseval Stiefel manifold, fixed throughout a strong deformation.
Right/precomposition O3-equivariance, and induced O3/SO3 quotient strong retractions, preserved exactly. No simultaneous two-sided-equivariance claim.
Full f_I straightening and h_I projective pseudoline coarsening, including covering-lift continuity and single-crossing preservation at geometric degenerations, retained with original diagrams.

Finite g_I uses nested induction, early stopping, distance to complements of domains and stability of alternate bases. The special all-unused-weights-zero continuity argument remains distinct from continuity of stopping times on U_I.
Infinite construction uses compatible finite-prefix deformations with eventually trivial tail and direct-limit continuity, not naive metric convergence or an arbitrary infinite product.
Polar normalization q(A,t) and complete bundle application supplied; paracompact bases and exact universal-bundle categories retained.

Old2061 contraction, individual claims, finite/infinite cases, quotient versions and applications are not independent extra IDs; open MacPhersonian/double-equivariance/higher-rank questions remain source context.
